messages:
Asha: Heads-up — onboarding Momentum's LoRA patch for customer 'Momentum' hitting weird tokenization mismatch in 4bit quant. Diffs in merge apply clean but outputs garbled on some prompts.

Matt: saw that in quickpack eval. Perplexity spikes on code snippets and dates. Is this after our tokenizer update?

Jin: they used a custom tokenizer during finetune. @asha can you confirm vocab hash?

Asha: yep, fine-tuned with tokenizer v2.1 (sha: 3f4b). Our runtime uses v2.0 in hosted variant — that explains detokenization mismatch.

Carla: customer expects go-live next week, any quick mitigations?

Oliver: short term we can route them to a fallback variant (no-merge) + apply on-the-fly token mapping. Perf impact ~+10ms.

Matt: suggest smoke eval pack: subset of 40 user prompts, include code and date parsing. I'll run now.

deploy-bot: smoketest started for thread 1852506789 — runner id smokepack-485

Matt: results: 40/40 ran; 12 failures with tokenization shifts. sample:
```input: 'Translate: 2022-11-05'
expected: '2022-11-05'
actual: '2022 - 11 - 05'
```

Asha: ok plan: (1) back-merge tokenizer v2.1 into runtime for this customer via per-tenant tokenizer override, (2) re-run smoke pack, (3) if pass, deploy canary to 5% traffic. :thumbsup:

Carla: ok. Customer will accept canary. Jin pls coordinate config change with infra.

Jin: will do. tagging infra: @oliver please hold a quick validation run after canary.

Oliver: on it. ETA 3 hours.

Matt: noted added to rollout checklist. any docs needed? I'll add note in customer config: 'tokenizer_override: v2.1'

Carla: thanks. I'll message Momentum to set expectations. :wave:
